title: A prefix range
note: `k0` is `k/` with its last byte incremented, and the range excludes it. Ending the range at `k/ÿ` instead looks equivalent and is not: a key of `k/` followed by two 0xff bytes sorts after it and would be missed.

title: The range that ends before it starts
note: An interval that is empty because its end sorts before its start is still a well-formed question, and the answer is simply that no key is in it. Refusing it with an error is the mistake.
